answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on Zh ⇒ En and De ⇒ En translation tasks ...

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use the widely used metrics BLEU , BLEURT , and COMET . We use ScareBLEU , BLEURT-20 and Unbabel/wmt22-comet-da in the evaluation implementations.

answer_4.quote: We randomly pick 100 sentences from Zh ⇒ En and De ⇒ En test sets, and recruit three human judges for evaluation. For each sentence, the judges read the source sentence and two candidate translations ... The judges are required to rate each candidate on a scale of 1 to 5 and pick the better one.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each candidate translation on a scale of 1 to 5 and select the better translation.
